summary: Daytona includes $200 in free compute with its free trial, with no credit card required. Free-credit balances cannot be used for GPU sandboxes. Current pricing lists storage at $0.000108 per GiB/hour after the first 5 free GiB; this is a storage-pricing allowance, not extra cash credit.
claim_steps: Open Daytona pricing and choose the free trial.
Create a Daytona account; the official page says no credit card is required.
Use the $200 free compute balance on eligible non-GPU sandboxes.

social_proof.title: Daytona Pricing
social_proof.text: Use what you need, when you need it. $200 in free compute included. Sign up for a free trial — no credit card required. Storage GiB $0.000108/h. Price per GiB after first 5 free.

social_proof.title: Billing | Daytona
social_proof.text: Free credit balance: the amount of free credits; not available for GPU sandboxes. Daytona consumes free credits before paid credits.
